review_description: The process was simple and clear from day one. I felt well-informed when deciding to proceed with the installation.The team also accommodated a separate roof painting job that I had going by only installing the brackets initially, then returning later on after the roof painting was completed.After the installation was complete, I received a thorough explanation of the system, and the team promptly arranged the connection on my behalf with the energy network.Satisfied customer with a quality system.
